Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Recent allies of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.Ei698TPekL0hRbUS]{Salubri} antitribu - sometimes called the Furies - care little for the sect's broader ideology, joining out of necessity and shared hatred of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, whom they blame for destroying their clan's progenitor. Driven by vengeance, they fight as furious, almost cult-like zealots devoted to avenging their founder, though private grudges can easily distract them from larger goals.

Disciplines: Auspex, Fortitude, Valeren

Advantage: The warrior Salubri antitribu command Valeren, the martial Discipline of the healers' cousins.

Disadvantage: Each Salubri antitribu bears the clan's third eye, which opens and becomes visible when Disciplines are used, and — like all Salubri — the bloodline is hunted by the Tremere who slander them.

Organization: The Salubri antitribu function almost as a cult bound by shared grief and vengeance, their fervor giving them purpose even as outsiders to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s wider cause.
